svg.text: ikea-sales — End-to-End Synthetic UK Sales Data Platform
GCP (BigQuery) · Terraform for Infra · Airflow 3.3.2 for Orchestration · dbt for 22B-Row Modelling · FastAPI for Web Delivery
Google Cloud BigQuery — project ikea-sales (provisioned by terraform/)
ONSPD (postcodes & coordinates) · IKEA catalog · census names · street names · store locations · postcode areas
dim_numbers (100M partitioned storage blocks) → int_order_sizes (inlined 1M CDF basket slots) → int_order_products
dim_customers (70,000,000 UK profiles) · dim_products (IKEA catalogue) · dim_stores
dim_postcodes (lat/long delivery boundary filter) · agg_sales_grid_10km (1,351 cells) · agg_sales_by_postcode_district
audit.* — automated data integrity & financial reconciliation (dbt)
inputs_vs_outputs_checks (14 automated reconciliation tests: exact 6B orders, £725B reconciliation, VAT rates, timeline sequences)
FastAPI Web Applications (make invoice / make heatmap)
Direct point lookup by Order ID + Postcode → Authentic IKEA VAT invoice (Code 128 SVG)
UK sales density over 10km grid (Leaflet continuous zoom + ONS GeoJSON boundaries)
3 · dbt run → dbt test → dbt audit
4 BigQuery Datasets: ingest, transform, serve, audit
Data flow: download (source_*.py) → local data/ files → upload (ingest_*.py) → BigQuery (ingest → transform → serve → audit) → FastAPI apps.
